methods.label: Simplify and combine like radicals
methods.explanation:
Factor out the perfect-square parts so that both terms contain the same remaining square root. Using \(\sqrt{ab}=\sqrt a\sqrt b\) for \(a,b\ge0\), we get
\[
\sqrt8+\sqrt{18}
=\sqrt{4\cdot2}+\sqrt{9\cdot2}
=2\sqrt2+3\sqrt2
=5\sqrt2.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{5\sqrt2}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
